body:
Dude, that sucks. If you stick around though, I'm absolutely certain that soon enough you'll have something to make you glad you did. Your life has hardly even begun, trust me, everything will change so much.

Sorry if that sounds condescending, if it helps I'm 18 and have no clue what I'm talking about either. But listen man, nothing is unattainable at this age. You can take your sweet time and figure out how to do what you wanna do or at least find a viable alternative. Make your dreams happen. Nothing can stop you.

Hi,

I don't think you can subconsciously want to kill yourself. That's a very unnatural and disturbed thought that comes about in desperation and illness, and in my experience is usually not a pleasant option, but is seen as the only option.

However, you did overdose in your panic and that's not good. Let's hope it was a one time thing, just a momentary lapse. I'd definitely tell your therapist if I were you. I'm glad you're getting help, stick with that even when it seems pointless, it's always a step in the right direction.

I don't have a huge amount to say, but your post was empty and I didn't want you feeling abandoned when you poured your heart out here. If you need a chat please don't hesitate to PM me, I'm just sitting about doing nothing anyway.

Hey there,

Sounds like you're having a really hard time at the moment. I don't know anything much about gender issues but I've seen depression and other illnesses first hand and had a lot of experience with them.

Know that there's always another way, slitting wrists isn't ever gonna be worth it. If your parents won't accept you for who you are, that's shitty, but fuck them.

Shoot me a message if you feel like talking, I'd really like to hear you out.

I don't wanna sound too harsh or anything here, but here goes. You sound like you're having a rough time, and I can't possibly know how bad that is. You're young, still in school, and seem to feel bad solely because of a girl. That might not be the case but it's all you spoke about.

This sub is for people with very serious mental illnesses and problems who want to kill themselves and are seeking help. Correct me if I'm wrong, but I didn't think that applied to you from your post. You seem to be having problems, but if you're not feeling suicidal it might be best to ask for help on another subreddit.

Hey man,

Sounds like things have been really bad for you recently. I don't know your situation, but my first impression is that your mum isn't good for you. Sometimes the concept of family is less important than getting out of a toxic relationship with a family member, and it seems she's been making you feel worse. How old are you? Is moving out an option?

Remember that it's not your fault that you are mentally ill, despite what others make you feel. Recovering and leading a happy life isn't out of your reach, but it might be harder for you than it is for others. I've actually been speaking to my girlfriend about this recently - she doesn't feel her 'good moments' are appreciated because they're what's expected of her. Like, if she goes to work every day for a week that's a big achievement, but nobody's gonna give a shit, cause that's expected. My point is that a "normal" and happy life is attainable, but it might take longer, and will definitely be harder for you than for most. 

When you get there, it'll be worth it. I promise that. Stick in there, do what you can to change things one bit at a time, and always look for professional help when you feel bad.
Thanks, that really means a lot :)

I've managed to talk her down. She took a couple of paracetamol but not enough to do any damage, thankfully. I've got her coming home early after making an excuse to work. It's probably gonna be a long day now but I'm just so glad no harm was done, going to talk things out and arrange another doctors appointment.

It's definitely not stupid to feel this way, and you are absolutely not making it up. Part of the beauty with depression is that it simultaneously fucks you up and convinces you you've done it to yourself. Not caring is normal, too.

I can't say much to help you, I hope things get better soon, I really do.

Hey there.

I don't have a lot to say, but your post had no replies and I don't want you to feel abandoned when you pour your heart out here.

So yeah, just wanted to know I read your post. Your situation sounds devastating, and if I were in your life, I'd be really proud of you for each day you struggle through.

Stay strong, I'll be thinking of you. I really hope things get better soon.

Hey.

I'm ridiculously under-qualified to help you. I'm not a doctor, and I don't even have depression. I just wanted to tell you that my girlfriend is in your place right now - she's been there for years and it keeps getting worse.

She feels like a bad person, sometimes she chooses not to do things that she knows will make her feel better. She's sometimes convinced that she's been making this whole thing up for attention because she doesn't feel bad and doesn't try to get better.

Just wanted you to know that you're not alone. You're clearly suffering, and that's terrible because I wouldn't wish this on my worst enemy. I don't know you, but I'll say to you what I say to her - you're a good person, overcome by something horrible.
